transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Thursday, September 10. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Apple's 1st foldable phone launched: Specifications, features and price in India of iPhone Duo. Apple has launched the iPhone Duo, its first foldable phone, at rupees 2,99,900 in India. It opens to a 7.6-inch display with a 5.4-inch screen outside, runs the A20 Pro chip, and carries a battery on each side for up to 24 hours of use. Touch ID replaces Face ID, and the phone is eSIM-only. Pre-orders open on October 16, with sales from October 23. Brazil versus India: Vinicius Jr, Raphinha set for historic Kolkata showdown. Brazil's new coach Carlo Ancelotti has named a 26-player squad for upcoming matches. The team will face Australia twice in September and then India. This selection marks a significant reshaping of the national team after their World Cup exit. Ancelotti is looking to integrate young talent for future tournaments. Apple iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max launched: Price in India and all details. Apple has just revealed its exciting new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max smartphones, equipped with the state-of-the-art A20 Pro chip and powered by iOS 27. These models come packed with impressive camera enhancements and advanced AI functionalities via Apple Intelligence. Pre-orders kick off on September 12, with global availability beginning on September 18. In India, the Pro model will start at rupees 1,64,900. Zelenskyy's plane nearly hit by drone while taking off from Moldova. A plane carrying Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy narrowly avoided a collision with an unidentified drone while taking off from Moldova en route to Oslo for the funeral of King Harald V. 'A ball won't kill you, but bullets can': Rashid Khan on childhood in Afghanistan. As Afghanistan prepare to face India in a three-match T20I series, starting Sunday at the Arun Jaitley Stadium in Delhi, star all-rounder Rashid Khan opened up about the challenges he faced as a child in the war-torn country and how those experiences helped shape his mindset. 1980s AI photo trend: 11 ChatGPT prompts to turn photos into retro Bollywood looks. Users are transforming photos into 1980s Bollywood styles using ChatGPT. This trend recreates vintage movie hero and heroine looks with specific prompts. It allows for creating magazine covers and wedding album pictures easily. Detailed prompts ensure authentic hairstyles, clothing, and lighting effects. West Asia conflict likely hindrance to cementing Brics declaration. NEW DELHI: India's push for agreement at the BRICS summit beginning Sept 12 faces divisions among its members over the West Asia conflict. Gaur Gopal Das Quote: Small daily actions build discipline; big wins follow slowly. Gaur Gopal Das highlights the importance of small, consistent actions in achieving lasting success. He warns that ignoring tiny tasks can foster bad habits. By mastering these seemingly minor details, one cultivates discipline and preparation for larger responsibilities. This principle resonates in various fields, ranging from medical practices to aviation. £8.28M Cotswolds mansion gutted by fire months after sale. An £8.28 million Grade II-listed Cotswolds mansion has suffered extensive damage after an electrical fire tore through the historic property. Barton House, a 17th-century manor near Guiting Power, was bought by a private owner in January 2025. The owners said they were "in so much shock" as firefighters battled the blaze for nearly 12 hours. Creating a multi-layered security grid in Delhi, one Brics at a time. NEW DELHI: When the 'Flying Kremlin' and other ultra-secure aircraft touch down in Delhi this weekend, they won't just bring Russian President Vladimir Putin and other high-profile world leaders to the Brics Summit, they will land with a fully autonomous fortress-on-wheels featuring personal food-testing labs, decoy dignitaries and armoured limousines built to survive landmines and chemical attacks. 'Toxic' box office day 15: Worldwide gross reaches rupees 339.32 cr. Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups box office collections continue to decline. The film earned sixty lakhs on its fifteenth day of release. Its total India net collection has now reached two hundred forty-seven point eighty-five crores. Worldwide gross collection stands at three hundred thirty-nine point thirty-two crores. Apple increases prices of iPhone 17 series, iPhone Air and iPhone 16. With the unveiling of the iPhone 18 Pro series, Apple has raised prices for its devices in India. The iPhone 17e and iPhone 16 are also affected by substantial price increases. The iPhone 17 now retails for rupees 99,900, marked up by rupees 17,000, whereas the premium iPhone Air skyrocketed by rupees 30,000. Highlights of the new iPhone 17 encompass a 120Hz display and upgraded 48MP cameras.

Illegal Construction Within 100 Metres Of Van Vihar Under NGT Scanner, Action-Taken Report Sought In Bhopal. The NGT's Bhopal Bench has taken cognisance of alleged illegal construction within 100 metres of Van Vihar National Park's boundary. MP Nursing College Scam: High Court Slaps rupees 3 Lakh Fine Per Duplicate Faculty Member; Students Can Take Exams After Payment. The Madhya Pradesh High Court imposed a rupees 3 lakh penalty per duplicate faculty member on nursing colleges earlier declared "suitable". MP medical interns' protest enters Day 3 as they demand stipend hike, slam police 'action'. Intern doctors end stir in Bhopal as MP govt approves 50 percent hike in monthly stipend. 7 schoolkids injured as bus rams dumper in Bhind. Panchayats, Urban Local Bodies Must Generate Own Revenue Instead Of Relying On Government Grants, Says Finance Panel Chief In Indore. Sixth State Finance Commission Chairman Jaybhan Singh Pavaiya urged Panchayats and urban local bodies to develop independent revenue sources instead of relying solely on Central and State grants. transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. Nifty falls for third straight session; More pain ahead or relief rally on the cards?. The Nifty 50 extended its decline for the third consecutive trading session on Wednesday, falling 203.60 points or 0.86 percent to close at 23,431.50. L and T, IIFL Finance follow REC into India's emerging tokenised bond market. L and T raised rupees 500 crore and IIFL Finance rupees 25 crore through tokenised bonds, following REC's debut issue as issuers test the new blockchain-based settlement framework Sebi proposes easier director eligibility, norms for key MII officials. Markets regulator Sebi on Wednesday proposed changes to the eligibility criteria for directors on governing boards of market infrastructure institutions (MIIs), along with standard qualification and experience norms for key officials such as chief technology officers and chief information security officers. In its consultation paper, the regulator said the proposals are aimed at strengthening the governance of MIIs, which include stock exchanges, clearing corporations, and depositories. Sebi said MIIs faced practical difficulties finding suitable candidates, especially for public interest director positions, due to existing restrictions. These rules often disqualify expert candidates from joining an MII board if they are directors at any company even remotely linked to a stockbroker or trading member. But can it match BSE's extraordinary performance? Gold Steadies Near $4,400 as Traders Weigh Fed Rate-Hike Path. Gold steadied, as traders awaited US inflation data due later this week for clues to whether the Federal Reserve will hike interest rates. AI-Driven IPO Wave Set to Accompany Anthropic Listing. With the Labor Day holiday , and summer in the US , now officially over, the traditional push to the end of the year in the market for initial public offerings is on. Oil tops $100, rupee breaches 95/$ as stocks reel on US-Iran tensions. The rupee touched a low of 95.23 against the dollar before settling at 95.11 as Brent crude topped $100 a barrel; dealers cited RBI intervention in spot and swap markets Australian Property Stocks Vulnerable Following Bathla Collapse. Australia's property stocks are trailing global peers by the most in 16 years, and analysts worry it may get worse as the prospect of more rate hikes and the unraveling of a suburban developer intensify scrutiny in the sector. Net SIP inflows surge to record rupees 2 trillion in FY26 despite closures. Despite higher SIP account closures amid market turbulence, net inflows accounted for 56 per cent of gross SIP investments of rupees 3.5 trillion in FY26 Copper Hits Fresh All-Time Highs in New York and London. Copper climbed to a fresh record in London and New York as traders weighed persistent tariff fears and supply shortages against escalating hostilities in the Middle East that clouded demand outlook. iPhone Duo to AirPods 5: Everything Apple launched. CEO, IRB Infrastructure Developers said, Our strong toll revenue performance in August 2026 reflects the sustained traffic growth across our assets. The growth in traffic, coupled with the tariff revision implemented at the beginning of FY27, has further supported our revenue performance. He further said, With robust GDP growth indicating sustained economic activity, coupled with the onset of the festive season beginning with the Ganesh Festival, we expect the positive traffic momentum to continue. Trump's Air Force One slide accidentally deployed. US President Trump experienced a brief delay before his Texas trip due to an emergency slide deployment. Dollar trades near 7-month low against yen as oil settles above $100. GLOBAL-FOREX:Dollar trades near 7-month low against yen as oil settles above $100 Apple Watch Ultra 4 goes all-in on health at rupees 1,09,900. Today, Apple launched the Watch Ultra 4 with a starting price of rupees 109,900. Wheat falls amid profit-taking, Black Sea war headlines. GLOBAL-GRAINS/ (UPDATE 4):GRAINS-Wheat falls amid profit-taking, Black Sea war headlines Northern Coalfields improves operational performance with retreating rains. As the monsoon loosens its grip, Northern Coalfields (NCL), one of Coal India's major coal-producing subsidiaries, is picking up pace across its mines, with coal production rising by 67 percent and supply by 75 percent as on 8 September 2026 in comparison to average of 01 to 03 September 2026. AirPods 5 is here: ANC, Siri AI and more from $129. Apple's latest AirPods 5 earbuds feature improved audio and active noise cancellation. Japan's Biggest Pension Fund Needs a CalPERS Lesson. Traders closely study how pensions funds, controlling $73 trillion, plan to spend their firepower. But lately, the industry's biggest whales are creating outsized dislocation and trepidation in global currency and bond markets. The excessive market scrutiny and speculation that big pension funds are attracting now demands a rethink in portfolio management. Shakti Pumps wins order worth rupees 235 cr from MSEDCL. INR slumps beyond rupees 95/$ mark as Brent crude futures cross the USD 100 per barrel mark. The Indian rupee slumped by 34 paise to close at 95.08 (provisional) against the American currency on Wednesday as crude prices crossed the USD 100 per barrel mark, stoking concerns over inflation and high forex outflows. Weak equity markets and FII outflows also pressurised the rupee. Brent crude futures surpassed USD 100 a barrel for the first time in almost six weeks after attacks on oil facilities and ships in West Asia threatened to weaken the already strained supply chain amid the US-Iran tensions. Brent crude was trading higher by 2.5 per cent at USD 100.5 per barrel. NSE IPO: Exchange to freeze ISIN from September 11; no offline share transfers allowed until listing. The NSE will freeze its ISIN starting September 11, 2026, ahead of its IPO. Shareholders are advised against pledging shares during the freeze, which prevents transfers without corporate action. Additionally, Indian Bank and others plan to sell stakes as part of the offering process. GPT Infraprojects arm bags rupees 114.82-cr contract from Northeast Frontier Railways. transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Flexi cap funds: Bringing flexibility to your investment game. Flexi cap funds provide a unique opportunity for investors by spreading investments across large, mid, and small-cap companies, ensuring a well-rounded equity exposure. These dynamic funds empower professional managers to modify asset allocations in response to changing market conditions. Investors have the flexibility to choose between lump sum investments or systematic investment plans. Global Fintech Fest 2026: Agentic AI, tokenisation and quantum, how these 3 technologies could change how you invest. At the Global Fintech Fest 2026, agentic AI, tokenisation and quantum are the key themes of the event. These technologies could change how investors manage portfolios, access assets and assess risk over the next decade. Here's what it means for investors. Railway body seeks rupees 18,000+DA as bonus ceiling for Level-1 employees; higher for others; how it may impact staff. The Indian Railways Technical Supervisors' Association is pushing for an increase in the bonus ceiling for non-gazetted staff. They urge the government to revise the PLB, as it hasn't changed since 2014-15. Employee groups emphasise that the outdated limit fails to align with current pay scales, indicating that many railway employees would benefit from such a revision. rupees 34 lakh tax relief for F and O trader: Why ITAT Delhi rejected the 'speculative loss' tag. There could be an instance where, even when you have reported your credit card as lost/missing, an unauthorised transaction takes place because of the bank's fault. What then? Pharma mutual funds: Kotak Healthcare leads 1-year returns at over 28 percent , here's how others performed. Pharma and healthcare mutual funds have delivered positive returns over the last 1 year, but performance has varied sharply across schemes. While some active funds have gained more than 25 percent , several others have posted much lower returns. Employer gifts up to rupees 15,000 now tax-free: Here's what salaried taxpayers need to know about the higher limit. The Income Tax Rules, 2026 have raised the annual tax-free limit on employer-provided gifts, vouchers and tokens from rupees 5,000 to rupees 15,000. The benefit is available as an aggregate annual limit, not separately for each occasion. Student or parent: Who should be the primary borrower for education loan? Check repayment and tax implications before deciding. Determining whether a parent or a student should take on an education loan is an important decision. Although the student is the main borrower, having a co-borrower can be beneficial. It's essential to think about potential future income for repayment rather than merely focusing on admission offers. Canara Bank will offer interest from 2.50 percent to 4 percent , while Bank of India presents a range of 2.50 percent to 6.25 percent . IDFC FIRST Bank tops with rates from 2.50 percent to an impressive 7.00 percent , depending on the deposit amount. What's a Freedom Fund? 5 reasons it offers much more than emergency savings, helps you worry less about what-ifs of life. A freedom fund is a savings set aside to facilitate life changes, such as career breaks or relocations, without touching your emergency fund. Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund: What it bought and sold in August 2026; top 10 holdings revealed. Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund, India's largest mutual fund scheme, added DLF and Knowledge Realty Trust in August 2026 and exited one REIT. It also raised exposure to 10 holdings and trimmed one. Since then, the stock has risen sharply to $320, representing a gain of roughly 36 percent in dollar terms. rupees 34 lakh F and O trading loss: Income Tax dept calls it speculative, ITAT Delhi treats rupees 25 lakh as business loss.
